# Iolit

> Your AI subscription should pay you back.

Iolit is an open-source agent that captures metadata from your AI coding sessions (Claude, Cursor, Codex) and pays you for it. Local capture, consent before anything leaves, one audited network call.

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL iolit.dev/install | sh
```

## How it works

1. Install: a tiny agent for macOS or Linux, silent in the background.
2. Capture: detects Claude, Cursor, and Codex sessions, extracts metadata only (no code, no prompts, no identifiers).
3. Earn: monthly payouts via Stripe, sized by session quality and volume.

## Privacy

- The client is MIT-licensed and open source: https://github.com/Emad-log/iolit-client
- No source code uploaded
- No personal identifiers transmitted
- No keystroke logging or screenshots
- Pause or delete anytime
- One network call, CI-enforced: `scripts/check-network.js` fails the build if more than one call site exists

## Repos

- Site: https://github.com/Emad-log/iolit
- Client: https://github.com/Emad-log/iolit-client
- API: https://github.com/Emad-log/iolit-api
